title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1973-12-12
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a solid 1973 show, highlighted by Blue Suede Shoes, Peggy‑O and a tight Mississippi–Uptown Toodeloo medley.
ai_review.review: The Miller SBD provides crystal‑clear audio with a superb soundcheck that showcases the recording’s high fidelity. The concert is a strong, overlooked 1973 performance featuring solid playing throughout and standout renditions of Blue Suede Shoes, Thirty Days, El Paso, Peggy‑O, Half‑Step and a seamless Mississippi‑Uptown Toodeloo transition.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews note solid show performance (≈4) and excellent sound quality (≈5). Weighted average yields ~4.3 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean soundcheck; overall clear mix with no reported dropouts or muffiness; praised as a high‑fidelity SBD by multiple reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth set flow with solid playing throughout; the show balances upbeat rockers and folk numbers, highlighted by seamless transitions into the Mississippi‑Uptown Toodeloo medley.
